notes: This file holds every price the website can show. Every entry has a status: "confirmed" (the owner gave this exact number), "draft" (taken from old quote history, NOT signed off by the owner) or "unknown" (no number yet).
THE PUBLIC SITE shows a price ONLY when status is "confirmed" AND publish is true. Everything else shows "Call for a quote". Draft prices never appear on the public site.

PREVIEW builds (Netlify deploy previews and branch deploys, or a build with BC_PRICE_MODE=preview) also show draft prices and confirmed prices that are not yet approved to publish, each with a small "Draft price" tag, so the site can be reviewed with prices in place.

To make a price public: the owner confirms the number, then set status to "confirmed", fill amount (a plain number, no dollar sign), display (the words the site prints, for example "$80" or "From $350"), confirmed_by (who) and confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD), and set publish to true.
A confirmed price can stay private: leave publish false and the public site keeps saying "Call for a quote".

Unknown means amount, display, confirmed_by and confirmed_on are null. Never type a guess, a competitor's number, or a number for a vehicle the quote history does not cover. Never enter 0 to mean unknown.

Draft prices are the LOWEST figure in the quote history for that vehicle class, shown as a "From" price. They came from pricing-reference.md, which the owner has not signed off. Each draft entry names its source and the rows behind it in basis.

legal_hold true means the entry must never render anywhere, public or preview, whatever its status. full_windshield_film carries it until Chase rules: on a plain reading NRS 484D.440 allows windshield tint on the top strip only.

Auto tint packages follow the quote history: "Front doors" (Front/Sides in the worksheet), "Rear doors and back glass" (Rear/Sides) and "Full vehicle" (side and back glass; the worksheet's full vehicle is front plus rear on every row and does NOT include the windshield or sunroof). The windshield top strip and the sunroof are separate lines.

The Build Your Tint tool prices a build only when the windows picked can be covered exactly by packages and separate lines that are allowed to show. If any window cannot be priced, it shows "Call for a quote" instead of a partial total.

film_tiers and shades_installed are empty until the owner names the film lines and lists the shades the shop stocks. Until shades_installed has values, the tool shows example_shades with the label "Example shades; the shop confirms what it stocks".
Front door shades darker than 35 percent never get a price on the site. Nevada law, NRS 484D.440.

gate.production: status is confirmed AND publish is true AND legal_hold is not true
gate.preview: production rule, plus status draft or confirmed-but-unpublished, tagged "Draft price"; legal_hold still never shows
gate.preview_when: BC_PRICE_MODE=preview, or Netlify CONTEXT is deploy-preview or branch-deploy
